guest.emptyMenu: The menu hasn’t been published yet

guest.payAtTable: You pay at the table, with your waiter.

guest.cartItemGone: Some items are no longer available and were removed from your cart.
guest.confirmBody: Your waiter will review and confirm it. The countdown starts only after confirmation.

guest.estimateUpdated: Your waiter updated the preparation time
guest.delayBody: Preparation is taking a little longer than estimated. Thank you for your patience — your order is on its way.
guest.readyBody: Your waiter is bringing it to your table now.
guest.servedBody: Enjoy! You can order more whenever you like.
guest.rejectedBody: We’re sorry — your waiter couldn’t accept this order.
guest.invalidBody: Please ask the staff for help or scan another QR code.
guest.loadErrorTitle: The menu can’t be loaded right now
guest.loadErrorBody: Check your internet connection and try again.

waiter.soundHint: Sound alerts for new orders and calls
waiter.noActiveRooms: No room has an order right now.
waiter.taken: Another waiter has already taken this order
waiter.rejectBody: The guest is notified right away, with the reason you choose.
waiter.readyDone: The guest has been told the order is ready
waiter.timeUpdated: The new time has been sent to the guest
waiter.emptyNewHint: New orders appear here instantly, with a sound alert.
waiter.emptyActiveHint: Track accepted orders here until they are served.

login.title: Staff sign-in
login.subtitle: Enter the username and PIN you got from the venue’s owner or a manager.
login.subtitleEmail: Sign in with the account your venue owner gave you.
login.demoHint: Click an account to fill in its username and PIN, then sign in. Two tabs with different waiters show how an order gets claimed.

home.title: QR ordering for your venue
home.lede: Guests scan the code on the table and order from their phone; the waiter confirms and tells them how long it will take.
home.guestCardHint: The menu for Table 7, as after scanning the QR code
home.tip: Tip: open the guest and the waiter in two tabs side by side.
home.roomsHint: The first room on each floor. Every room and its QR code is in the admin panel.
home.supabaseLede: Guests open the menu by scanning the QR code on their table. Staff sign in here.
home.adminCardHint: Menu, tables & QR codes, staff, settings
home.adminCardHintHotel: Menu, tables, rooms & QR codes, staff, settings
home.editionCafeHint: Café, bar or restaurant: ordering from tables.
home.editionHotelHint: Hotel: tables plus room service from the rooms.

admin.title: Admin
admin.noAccessTitle: You don’t have access to the admin panel
admin.noAccessBody: This area is for the venue’s owner and managers only. You can still use the waiter dashboard.

overview.title: Overview
overview.noDataDay: There were no orders that day.
overview.barHint: Click a day in the chart to see just that day.

menu.title: Menu
menu.subtitle: Categories, products, prices and availability. Guests see changes the next time they open the menu.
menu.uncategorizedHint: Guests don’t see products without a category. Assign one in the product editor.
menu.deleteCategoryBody: The category disappears from the menu. It can only be deleted once it has no products.
menu.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. The image is resized automatically before upload.
menu.name: Name
menu.availabilityHint: When off, guests still see the product on the menu but can’t order it.
menu.optionsHint: For example size or type of milk. The first choice in a group is the default; any surcharge is added to the price.
menu.quiet: Don’t show on the order (standard choice)
menu.missingHint: You can save without it — guests using that language will see the Serbian text.
menu.nameRequired: Enter the product name in Serbian.
menu.invalidPrice: The price must be a whole number of dinars (e.g. 260).
menu.groupIncomplete: Every option group needs a name and at least one choice named in Serbian.
menu.deleteProductBody: The product disappears from the menu. Past orders stay as they were.

tables.title: Tables & QR codes
tables.subtitle: Every table has its own QR code. Guests scan it and get the menu for that table straight away — no app, no sign-up.
tables.subtitleHotel: Every table and every room has its own QR code. Guests scan it and get the menu straight away — no app, no sign-up.
tables.pdfReady: PDF downloaded — four cards per A4 page
tables.regenerateBody: The old code stops working immediately. Print the new card and replace it on the table.
tables.regenerated: The new QR code is ready
tables.removeBody: The table disappears from the waiter dashboard and its QR code stops working. Order history is kept.
tables.emptyHint: Add your first table to get its print-ready QR code.
tables.roomsHint: For example 101–130 for the first floor. Numbers that already exist are skipped, and every new room gets its own QR code.
tables.roomsNone: Every room in that range already exists.
tables.floorHint: 0 = ground floor. Leave empty if the floor doesn’t matter.
tables.emptyRoomsHint: Add rooms by number range, e.g. 101–130, and get a QR code for each one.

qr.scan: Scan to see the menu and order
qr.scanRoom: Scan to order to your room

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: Who can sign in to the waiter dashboard and the admin panel. Accounts without access stay on the list but can’t sign in.
staff.name: Full name
staff.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Hand it over in person. If an account with this email already exists, its password is not changed.
staff.demoNote: In demo mode the new member gets a username and PIN right away; both are listed on the sign-in page.
staff.selfLocked: You can’t change your own role or access.
staff.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change owners.

roleHints.manager: Menu, tables & QR codes, staff and venue settings.
roleHints.waiter: Waiter dashboard: orders, tables and calls.
roleHints.barista: Waiter dashboard: orders, tables and calls.

settings.title: Venue settings
settings.subtitle: Name, colour, contact details and guest rules. Changes apply right away, including in the guest menu.
settings.name: Venue name
settings.accentHint: Used for buttons and highlights in the guest menu and the dashboards.
settings.accentLowContrast: White text is hard to read on this colour — pick a darker shade.
settings.defaultLangHint: Guests can always switch the language in the menu.
settings.allowRepeat: New order before the previous one arrives
settings.allowRepeatHint: When off, a guest can order again only after their previous order has been served.
settings.callButtonHint: Shown at the bottom of the guest menu.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.too_many_items: This order is too large — please split it in two.
errors.too_fast: An order was just sent. Please wait a moment.
errors.order_in_progress: Please wait until your previous order has been served.
errors.unknown_product: One item is no longer on the menu.
errors.product_unavailable: One item has just sold out. Please check your cart.
errors.invalid_minutes: Enter a time between 1 and 180 minutes.
errors.invalid_status: The order status changed in the meantime.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have permission to do that.
errors.login_locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.not_staff: This account isn’t linked to any venue.
errors.anonymous_disabled: Turn on anonymous sign-ins in your Supabase settings.
errors.not_authenticated: Your session has expired. Please refresh the page.
errors.name_required: Enter a name (at least in Serbian).
errors.invalid_price: The price must be a whole number of dinars, from 0 to 1,000,000.
errors.invalid_number: The number must be between 1 and 9999.
errors.category_not_empty: This category still has products — move or delete them first.
errors.invalid_color: The colour must look like #RRGGBB, e.g. #A45A2E.
errors.cannot_change_self: You can’t change your own role or access.
errors.owner_required: Only an owner can assign or change the owner role.
errors.already_staff: This person is already on the staff.
errors.invalid_input: Some details aren’t valid. Please check the form.
errors.gone: This item was deleted in the meantime. Please refresh the page.
errors.weak_password: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.image_invalid: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image (up to 20 MB).
errors.upload_failed: The photo wasn’t uploaded. Please try again.
errors.invite_failed: The account wasn’t created. Check the email and try again.
errors.invite_unavailable: Adding staff isn’t set up on the server yet (the invite-staff function). See README.md.
errors.storage_full: The browser’s storage is full. Remove a photo or reset the demo data.
errors.invalid_range: The range must be within 1–9999, at most 300 rooms at a time.
errors.invalid_floor: The floor must be a whole number from 0 to 200 (0 = ground floor).
errors.demo_mode: In demo mode, sign in with a username and PIN.
errors.hotel_only: Rooms are part of the Stočić Hotel edition.
